description: Hand-labelled cases for ProofPilot's verifier. 'grounding': does SOURCE support CLAIM? 'conflict': do A and B contradict? Includes deliberately hard cases (paraphrases, near-misses) so the numbers reflect real limits.

grounding.claim: Python 3.12 was released in October 2023.
grounding.source: The Python Software Foundation released Python 3.12 on 2 October 2023, with improved error messages.

grounding.claim: LangGraph lets developers build stateful multi-agent workflows as graphs.
grounding.source: LangGraph is a library for building stateful, multi-actor applications with LLMs, modelling agent workflows as graphs.

grounding.claim: Rust guarantees memory safety without a garbage collector.
grounding.source: Rust achieves memory safety without garbage collection through its ownership and borrowing system.

grounding.claim: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris.
grounding.source: Standing on the Champ de Mars in Paris, the Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889.

grounding.claim: Intermittent fasting can lead to weight loss in adults.
grounding.source: Several randomized trials found that adults following intermittent fasting achieved modest weight loss.

grounding.claim: Streamlit is an open-source Python framework for data apps.
grounding.source: Streamlit is an open-source Python framework that lets data scientists build interactive data apps quickly.

grounding.claim: The hackathon accepts teams of up to three people.
grounding.source: You can compete either solo or in a team of up to 3 people.

grounding.claim: Vector databases store embeddings for similarity search.
grounding.source: A vector database indexes and stores embeddings so that similarity search over them is fast.

grounding.claim: Gemini 2.5 Flash is available on a free tier.
grounding.source: Developers can use Gemini 2.5 Flash on the free tier of the Gemini API with rate limits.

grounding.claim: Solar panel efficiency declines slightly each year.
grounding.source: Most photovoltaic modules lose roughly 0.5 percent of their output per year as they age.

grounding.claim: Many students use AI chatbots for homework help.
grounding.source: Surveys show a large share of learners now ask generative assistants for help with assignments.

grounding.claim: Docker containers share the host operating system kernel.
grounding.source: Unlike virtual machines, containers run on the host's kernel rather than booting their own.

grounding.claim: Python 3.12 was released in October 2023.
grounding.source: Python 3.11 brought major speed improvements and was released in 2022.

grounding.claim: LangGraph was created by Microsoft.
grounding.source: LangGraph is developed by LangChain Inc. as part of the LangChain ecosystem.

grounding.claim: Rust has a built-in garbage collector.
grounding.source: Go uses a concurrent garbage collector to manage memory automatically.

grounding.claim: The Eiffel Tower is 500 metres tall.
grounding.source: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai is about 828 metres tall and is the tallest building in the world.

grounding.claim: Intermittent fasting cures type 1 diabetes.
grounding.source: Intermittent fasting has been studied for weight loss, with mixed results on metabolic markers.

grounding.claim: Streamlit requires a paid licence for commercial use.
grounding.source: Flask is a lightweight WSGI web application framework written in Python.

grounding.claim: The hackathon deadline is in December.
grounding.source: Participants must join the community Discord to receive updates about prizes.

grounding.claim: Vector databases replace relational databases entirely.
grounding.source: Graph databases store nodes and edges and are optimised for relationship queries.

grounding.claim: Quantum computers can already break all RSA encryption.
grounding.source: Researchers estimate that breaking RSA-2048 would require millions of stable qubits, far beyond current machines.

grounding.claim: Coffee consumption causes dehydration.
grounding.source: Moderate coffee intake contributes to daily fluid needs, according to a review of hydration studies.

grounding.claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
grounding.source: The Great Wall of China stretches thousands of kilometres across northern China and attracts millions of visitors.

grounding.claim: Streamlit apps can be deployed for free on Community Cloud.
grounding.source: You can deploy Streamlit apps for free on Streamlit Community Cloud directly from a GitHub repository.
